script: Yaxel Lendeborg is just Jonathan Kuminga 2.0. Yaxel Lendeborg is a 6'9 power forward who doesn't have high IQ, he's pure athleticism and hustle. That's exactly who the Warriors just traded away with Jonathan Kuminga. The only difference is that Yaxel Lendeborg is older than Jonathan Kuminga. Yaxel Lendeborg failed out of high school, he had to go to JUCO and transfer D-1 to UAB, and then transfer to the University of Michigan just so that he could get in the spotlight. Yaxel Lendeborg was 24 years old playing college basketball, so he's not a star, he's just a guy who's been around longer than anybody else. Grades, learning, and IQ on the basketball court have always been Yaxel Lendeborg's downfall. So now he's going to join the Golden State Warriors, who have the most complex offensive system in the league, and he's going to be expected to set screens, slip, and play defense.
